A root canal is a highly effective treatment that helps save a severely damaged or infected tooth while relieving pain and preventing further dental complications. During the procedure, the infected pulp is carefully removed, the inside of the tooth is cleaned and disinfected, and the tooth is sealed to restore its strength and function. With modern dental techniques, root canal treatment is more comfortable than ever and can often be completed in just one or two visits.

Recovery is typically quick, with most patients returning to their normal routine within a day. Mild discomfort after the procedure is common and usually subsides within a few days. If you're experiencing persistent tooth pain, sensitivity, or swelling, don't wait for the problem to worsen. Schedule a consultation with our experienced dental team to protect your natural smile with timely root canal treatment.

Mumbai has become a preferred destination for dental implants because it combines experienced specialists, advanced dental technology, and high-quality treatment at competitive prices. Patients benefit from personalized care, modern implant techniques, and comprehensive treatment plans that restore both function and confidence.

At Bombay Dental Specialities, we provide customized dental implant solutions designed for long-lasting results and natural-looking smiles. Our skilled team uses advanced technology and premium materials to ensure a comfortable treatment experience and help you regain the ability to smile, speak, and eat with confidence.

For Invisalign treatment to be effective, most dentists recommend wearing your aligners for 20 to 22 hours per day. Aligners should only be removed for eating, drinking anything other than water, brushing, and flossing. Consistent wear helps ensure your teeth move according to your treatment plan and can prevent delays in achieving your desired results.

Wearing Invisalign as directed not only improves treatment efficiency but also helps maintain comfort as your teeth gradually shift into place. Skipping hours or frequently removing your aligners may slow progress and extend treatment time. Regular dental checkups can help ensure your Invisalign journey stays on track and delivers the best possible smile.

A CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) scan provides a detailed 3D view of your teeth, jawbone, nerves, and surrounding oral structures, helping dentists diagnose and plan treatments with greater accuracy. At Bombay Dental Specialities, we use advanced CBCT technology to support procedures such as dental implants, root canal therapy, wisdom tooth extractions, orthodontics, and TMJ evaluations.

Unlike traditional dental X-rays, a CBCT scan delivers comprehensive images that help detect hidden issues and create personalized treatment plans for better outcomes. Our experienced team is committed to ensuring a comfortable, safe, and efficient imaging experience, giving you the confidence to make informed decisions about your oral health.

Malocclusion, or a misaligned bite, is a common dental condition that affects how the upper and lower teeth fit together. It can lead to difficulties with chewing, speech issues, jaw discomfort, and uneven tooth wear. Common types include overbite, underbite, crossbite, and open bite. Understanding the causes and symptoms is the first step toward maintaining better oral health.

At Bombay Dental Specialities, we provide comprehensive diagnosis and personalized treatment options for malocclusion. Depending on the severity, treatment may include braces, clear aligners, retainers, or other orthodontic solutions. Our experienced dental team helps patients achieve improved function, comfort, and a healthier, more confident smile.

Persistent tooth pain, prolonged sensitivity to hot or cold, swelling in gums, or darkening of a tooth may be key signs you may need a root canal treatment. In some cases, pain while chewing or recurring infection can indicate nerve damage inside the tooth that requires immediate dental attention.

Bombay Dental Specialties offers expert diagnosis and advanced root canal treatment using modern technology and painless techniques. Our experienced dentists ensure accurate evaluation, infection control, and long-lasting dental care. Visit us for safe, comfortable, and effective treatment to restore your oral health and smile. Early treatment can prevent tooth loss and further complications. Schedule a consultation today. Trusted care.!!

Smoking can significantly affect the success of dental implants by reducing blood flow to the gums and slowing the healing process. Tobacco use increases the risk of infection, implant failure, and bone loss around the implant. Patients who smoke may experience longer recovery times and a lower long-term success rate for their dental implants.

At Bombay Dental Specialties, we educate patients about the factors that influence implant success and provide personalized care to help achieve the best results. If you're considering dental implants, our experienced team can guide you through every step and help protect your smile for years to come. Book your consultation today.

Did you know some everyday foods can quietly damage your teeth? Sticky candies, citrus fruits, potato chips, soft drinks, and even dried fruits can weaken enamel and increase the risk of cavities. Acidic and sugary foods create the perfect environment for tooth decay, especially when proper oral hygiene is ignored. Regular dental checkups can help spot early signs of damage before they become serious problems.

At Bombay Dental Specialties, we help patients protect their smiles with expert dental care and preventive treatments. Learning which foods affect your teeth can make a big difference in maintaining strong, healthy teeth for years to come. Book your dental visit today and keep your smile bright and healthy.

At Bombay Dental Specialities, we provide expert Invisalign guidance and personalized dental care to help you achieve comfortable and effective teeth alignment. featured_reviews.name: Srikanth R
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an excellent experience at Tusk Dental Clinic. Dr Balasubramaniam Shankar, the dentist was extremely professional, patient, and took the time to explain every step of the procedure in a clear and reassuring way.
The clinic ambience was calm, modern, and very well-maintained, which immediately put me at ease. Everything was spotlessly clean and hygiene standards were clearly a top priority. The staff was also warm and welcoming, making the entire visit smooth from start to finish.
A composite filling done, and I’m genuinely impressed with the result — the colour match was perfect and completely natural-looking. You can’t even tell any work was done! The procedure itself was very gentle and there was barely any discomfort.
The Doctor made sure I understood how to take care of the filling and maintain oral hygiene going forward. What, I really appreciated was the detailed post-treatment instructions provided in WhatsApp as well.
Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for skilled, caring, high-quality dental treatment and value for money!
